decls.name: Lemma25ProjectionInjective
decls.rationale: Lemma 2.5, part 1: the first-coordinate projection \(\pi_1\) is injective on a coset of \(\Lambda\) (two points with the same first coordinate differ by \(\Phi(D^{-1}\beta)\) with \(\sigma_1(\beta) = 0\), forcing \(\beta = 0\)); hence \(|P| = |X|\).
